newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli planes rocket south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli planes rocket south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli planes on Wednesday fired rockets at suspected guerrilla targets in the south Lebanon highlands, security sources said.

They said two jets fired a total of four rockets into a valley near the Iqlim al-Toufah mountain ridge which is controlled by pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas and lies just north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
There was no immediate word on casualties or damage in the raid.
Hizbollah uses the rugged Iqlim al-Toufah to launch attacks on Israeli troops in the 15-km (nine-miles) wide zone.
